_comment: Hand-maintained INPUTS for tools/build-grades.mjs (Bangers Scouting Grades v1, Sep 24 2026). Every value is a dated fact with a source. Prices are SportsCardsPro dated sold data for the raw 1st Bowman Chrome Auto (#CPA) - never eBay asks (R20). Stats are 2026 season totals (MLB Stats API, read 2026-09-24). Ranks are the MLB Pipeline in-season re-rank of 2026-08-13. Re-read before every re-grade; never carry a value forward without re-reading it.

sources.prices: SportsCardsPro product pages, 2026 Bowman Chrome Prospect Autograph (ungraded), read 2026-09-24 in Chrome
sources.ranks: MLB Pipeline Top 100 + team Top 30 (in-season update 2026-08-13), mlb.com/milb/prospects
sources.draft: statsapi.mlb.com draft hydrate (pick, bonus); IFA bonuses from MLB Pipeline reports
sources.path: MLB Pipeline ETA; 2026 MLB starts by position; org Top 30 order

players.name: Andrew Fischer

path.note: No settled MLB 3B (Hamilton, Rengifo, Ortiz split starts); no higher-ranked org prospect at 3B.

players.news: 48 HR — most in a minor-league season since 1982; BA's Brewers Minor League Player of the Year. Not in the Top 100 on contact concerns (34% K).

players.name: Ethan Holliday
players.statLine: .262/.395/.557 in 152 PA (Single-A) before a foot stress fracture

path.note: Tovar holds SS long-term; Pipeline projects him at 3B. Rockies #1 prospect.

players.news: Left-foot stress fracture in May ended his season early.

path.note: Duran, Abreu and Anthony hold the MLB outfield; he is Boston's top OF prospect.

players.name: Edward Florentino

path.note: Reynolds (LF), Cruz (CF), Valdez (RF) in Pittsburgh; Pirates' top OF prospect.

players.news: 2026 Futures Game (NL). Ankle injury slowed his spring.

players.name: Seong-Jun Kim
players.statLine: .287/.392/.522 in 186 PA (ACL / Single-A); 14.2 IP, 0.61 ERA as a pitcher

path.note: Seager holds SS long-term; Walcott, Castillo and Comeau (SS/3B) rank above him in the org.

players.news: Two-way debut at Hickory Aug 19 (2 IP, 4 K) after finishing high school in Korea.

players.name: Marek Houston

path.note: No settled Twins SS, but Culpepper (#31 overall) is already in the majors ahead of him.

players.news: Reached Double-A Wichita in his first full season.

players.name: Gage Jump
players.statLine: MLB: 20 starts, 98.2 IP, 5.47 ERA, 108 K / 46 BB

path.note: In the A's MLB rotation; shut down Sep 15 (left shoulder impingement).

players.news: Graduated — debuted in May (2.93 ERA first 7 starts, 7.21 last 13). The market now moves to his MLB rookie card.

players.name: Aiva Arquette
players.statLine: .272/.326/.459, 12 HR, 21 SB in 291 PA (A+ / AA) around three injuries

path.note: Otto Lopez holds MLB SS; no Marlins SS prospect ranks above him.

players.news: Core-muscle surgery (Feb 28), then wrist soreness and a six-week left-thumb IL stint from Jun 30; back and playing at Double-A.

path.note: Gunnar Henderson holds SS, Jackson Holliday is on the MLB infield; no Orioles SS prospect above him.

players.name: Daniel Pierce

path.note: Walls and Carson Williams in Tampa; Grady Emerson (#10 overall) and Cooper Flemming rank above him.

players.news: Left-shoulder subluxation needed surgery; expected back by spring 2027.
